title: How to Choose an Alle's ClinX Product by Task
excerpt: Choose an Alle's ClinX product by defining the area, required cleaning outcome, surface and soil, then confirming the product fit, approved instructions and recurring use pattern.
seo_title: How to Choose an Alle's ClinX Product by Task | Alle's ClinX
meta_description: Use a task-first method to choose an Alle's ClinX product based on area, outcome, surface, soil, product fit and operating pattern.
content_html:
The most reliable way to choose an Alle's ClinX product is to start with the cleaning task rather than the product name. Define what must be cleaned, what outcome is required and what surface and soil are involved before narrowing the catalogue.

Start with the area

Identify where the work will happen: for example a patient room, washroom, kitchen, factory floor, classroom or guest room. The area helps define the operating context and possible constraints.

Define the primary outcome

Decide whether the job is routine cleaning, disinfection, descaling, degreasing, dishwashing, laundry, hand hygiene, metal care, polishing or another specific task. Choose the primary outcome rather than trying to make one product cover unrelated tasks.

Match the surface and soil

Check the material being cleaned and the type or severity of soil. Acid-sensitive surfaces, aluminium, polished finishes, fabrics and heavy grease can require very different chemistry.

Narrow to the smallest practical product set

Choose products whose documented intended use matches the task. Avoid unnecessary overlap when one approved product already covers the recurring need.

Confirm the approved instructions

Before use, check the label and available TDS/SDS or usage guide for dilution, PPE, contact conditions, compatibility and other relevant requirements.

Then consider the recurring use pattern

Frequency, dilution and workload influence how much product the facility will actually consume. Metricon can help translate those inputs into usage and cost estimates.

Use Nova or support when the fit is unclear

When the label or product page does not answer an edge case, Nova can help search Alle's ClinX product information, or the support team can confirm a suitable option for the described task.

Practical takeaway

Choose by area → task → surface and soil → product fit → approved instructions → use pattern. Product selection should follow the job, not the other way around.
